chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

Regarding a man who bought an animal, but did not have its price with him, so he came to a man from among his companions and said: 'O so-and-so, pay on my behalf, and the profit will be between me and you.' So he paid on his behalf, then the animal died.
He said: 'The price is upon both of them, because if there had been profit, it would have been between them both.'

key_terms.الثَّمَنُ: the financial liability of the price
key_terms.انْقُدْ: pay in cash or settle the price

ai.seo_question: If two people agree to share the profit of a purchase, do they also share the loss and liability?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a shared financial arrangement in a purchase. Since both parties agreed to share the profit, they also share the liability of the price when the animal perishes, establishing reciprocal responsibility in partnership-like transactions.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
regarding a man who bought an animal but did not have its price, so he went to one of his companions and said: "O so-and-so, pay on my behalf, and the profit will be shared between me and you."
The companion paid on his behalf, but the animal died.
Imam (as) said: "The price is upon both of them because if there had been a profit, it would have been shared between them."
